subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world multi-step word problems involving polynomial or rational functions, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student models a realistic scenario (rate combination, work problems) using a rational or polynomial equation
exercise.pictorial: Student draws a model representing the problem before setting up the equation
exercise.abstract: Student solves a real-world polynomial or rational function word problem and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: sets up a work/rate problem with the rates combined incorrectly (added instead of as reciprocals, or vice versa)

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
